extracted.name: Mushroom Masala dry
extracted.description: Great recipe for Mushroom Masala dry.
ingredient_lines: Garam masala or all spices masala
instruction_lines: Take a pan and add oil of your choice
Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, spices like bay leaves
Add the ginger garlic paste,onion, saute it. After that add tomatoes and saute it.once it's cooked,add mushrooms.
Add turmeric powder,chilli flakes,garam masala powder and saute it make a thick dry gravy.
Now add cilantro and serve it
